messages.author: 9f3d5380c6845868
messages.subject: Stan Install Issues?
parts:
I ran into some install issues for stan that you folks may be able to help me debug:

src/stan/gm/grammars/expression_grammar_inst.cpp:6:   instantiated from here
/usr/lib/gcc/x86_64-redhat-linux/4.1.2/../../../../include/c++/4.1.2/bits/stl_iterator_base_types.h:129: error: no type named ‘iterator_category’ in ‘_ForwardIterator2’
/usr/lib/gcc/x86_64-redhat-linux/4.1.2/../../../../include/c++/4.1.2/bits/stl_iterator_base_types.h:130: error: no type named ‘value_type’ in ‘_ForwardIterator2’
/usr/lib/gcc/x86_64-redhat-linux/4.1.2/../../../../include/c++/4.1.2/bits/stl_iterator_base_types.h:131: error: no type named ‘difference_type’ in ‘_ForwardIterator2’
/usr/lib/gcc/x86_64-redhat-linux/4.1.2/../../../../include/c++/4.1.2/bits/stl_iterator_base_types.h:132: error: no type named ‘pointer’ in ‘_ForwardIterator2’
/usr/lib/gcc/x86_64-redhat-linux/4.1.2/../../../../include/c++/4.1.2/bits/stl_iterator_base_types.h:133: error: no type named ‘reference’ in ‘_ForwardIterator2’
make: *** [bin/stan/gm/grammars/expression_grammar_inst.o] Error 1

I'm on rhel5, and make gives the following call:

g++ -I src -I lib/eigen_3.1.2 -I lib/boost_1.53.0 -Wall -DBOOST_RESULT_OF_USE_TR1 -DBOOST_NO_DECLTYPE -DBOOST_DISABLE_ASSERTS   -c -O0 -o bin/stan/gm/grammars/expression_grammar_inst.o src/stan/gm/grammars/expression_grammar_inst.cpp

Thank you!  I'll do my best to provide additional information if I can!

~Alex

messages.author: 8aa9b8cc06fdc99c
messages.subject: Re: [stan-users] Stan Install Issues?
parts:
You need to use a more recent version of gcc.
4.1.2 is ancient.

I think the minimum we require is 4.2.1, but I'm not
sure that's enough on Linux. I'd recommend 4.7.2 (the
latest is 4.8.0, but we haven't tested it extensively
because it came out after our last release).

- Bob

messages.subject: Re: [stan-users] Stan Install Issues?

Thank you for the suggestions!  The sysadmins were able to update gcc for me, but now I'm having problems setting it up!  In particular, I don't know which environment variables I can change to use the correct compiler - I tried setting CC and GCC and CXX environment variables from within R and from the shell, but the old version of the compiler kept getting called anyway.

I was able to compile the command line version, but I'm not sure how to install the compiled libraries and R code without the install.packages bit.  I think the optimal solution would be to tell R somehow to compile from source using my compiler of choice, but barring that, knowing how to set up the compiled libraries by hand would be great.

Thanks very much!

messages.author: 743bbacc59f4b25f
messages.subject: Re: [stan-users] Stan Install Issues?
parts:
You need to put something like this in a file called Makevars with a directory called .R in your home directory on the server:

goodrich@CYBERPOWERPC:~$ cat .R/Makevars
CC=gcc-4.7
CXX=g++-4.7

possibly changing 4.7 to some other number. This is documented at

http://cran.r-project.org/doc/manuals/r-release/R-admin.html#Customizing-package-compilation

Ben
